evidence.reason: The containment check rejects an opaque binary published diff (lines 1306-1308) but applies no equivalent guard to `head_patch`. Since `diff_changed_locations()` derives locations from text hunks, a head diff that git renders as `Binary files ... differ` (e.g. a follow-up commit replacing the repaired text file with a binary blob while leaving its mode unchanged) yields empty head locations; `change_undone()` then finds no overlap, the mode check passes because the mode is unchanged, and line 1323 records `contained` even though the published text repair is gone. This is ordinary correctness of the existing containment proof, not a new requirement: the same reasoning already justifies the published-side binary rejection, and the fix is the smallest symmetric one — raise the existing "needs revalidation" error when `head_patch` is a binary diff, keeping the identical-blob fast path and text-hunk comparison.
